title: RealtimeHateSpeechModelOutput
description: Response the hate speech detection model must return to realtime_classification_ctrl.

prediction.description: Predicted label. 'bullying' maps to 'hate-speech' and 'no-bullying' maps to 'no-hate-speech'. Any other value raises an error in the controller.

confidence.description: Map of label -> probability as a JSON object. Must contain the key matching 'prediction' (e.g. 'hate-speech' or 'bullying').
